batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: st SV Samson b R Tewatia

batting.name: SK Raina
batting.dismissal: c S Dube b R Tewatia

batting.name: MM Ali
batting.dismissal: st SV Samson b R Tewatia

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: c GD Phillips b C Sakariya

batting.name: E Lewis
batting.dismissal: c JR Hazlewood b SN Thakur

batting.name: YBK Jaiswal

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c RD Gaikwad b SN Thakur

balls.text: yes, he can! Is that the biggest six of the season? Gaikwad raises the bat to soak in the applause of the dressing room. It's Gaikwad's maiden T20 century, that's one to cherish. He knew this was a length ball coming, picked his spot and swung that into the leg side to pick the bones out of that. Wayyyyyyy into the grass banks.  CSK have fired up the season's highest total along the way in the second leg.  Gaikwad has smashed 71 off the last 30 balls he has faced. What a knock, take a bow.
skiddy bouncer, good bouncer on leg stump. Gaikwad looked to take on the pull but was beaten for pace this time.
squeezed to deep cover, Gaikwad will get two balls to try and get to a maiden T20 century

he's toying with the bowling! The Fizz goes full and wide outside off, Jadeja takes a step across, gets down on one knee and this time uses his strong wrists and bottomhand to whip this into the gap at deep midwicket. So what if deep square was placed for the big hit?
fires a wide as he sees Jadeja trying to get across to swing into the leg side
woah! That is massive. Jadeja says he can swat them into the grassbanks too. It's the premeditated sweep, as he gets down on one knee, picks this low full toss and deposits over deep square.
sliced over point, and he's picked the gap perfectly. Third man was square but stood no chance
muscled into the gap between deep midwicket and long-on
hit down to long-off
swing and a miss. Looked to heave this wide yorker into the leg side
pulled but he has picked the gap at deep square! Slower delivery, Jadeja walked across, held his shape and then put that away into the gap
squeezes this yorker-length delivery from outside off towards midwicket, Dube had a lot of ground to cover from deep midwicket
goes length but slips this too far wide outside off, left alone.
full toss, he backs away and smears this to deep cover, Lewis was strolling across the ropes like he'd do on a holiday, Jadeja saw an opportunity and pinched the second easily
full toss again, cracked to deep point this time
full toss and he's smeared this between deep point and deep cover. Full, wide, Fizz misses, Jadeja picks the gap.
squeezes this drive to sweeper cover, they scamper back for a second
steps out and tries to squeeze this behind point but is beaten
crunchy drive to sweeper cover
bang! That's 95 metres, I am sure. Fizz goes short, it's a cutter Gaikwad picks off the hand and swats this over deep midwicket
full toss on leg stump, whipped to deep midwicket
steps out to the leg side and then goes over mid-off, this is sensational! Short fine dropped back, long-off came in and he found the gap
slower bouncer but way over the batter's head, wide called and rightly so
steps out and flays this slower delivery to deep cover
nips one back into middle, defends back
he's hoicked this across the line, completely deceived by the slower ball, but in hitting it to the long boundary at deep midwicket, he's picked out the lone man. Good catch by Phillips.
right into the blockhole, worked to deep midwicket
bunts this towards point, he'll keep strike.

he's clobbered this deep into the grass banks at deep square leg. This is poor from Akash. Bowls a short ball down leg at a friendly pace, it sat up nicely as Gaikwad picked it up and swatted that over the ropes.
lofted through the line, I'm kidding you not, it was just a mere push on the up. And it nearly carries to the long-off boundary. That is simply sensational
first real slog from Ruturaj! Gets a top-edge as it flies over Samson's head
short of length and angling away, bunted down to long-on
tucks this through midwicket
down on one knee as he half-pulls to deep square
eased down to long-on
gets well forward and jabs it away to the off side

well bowled! Sees Moeen stepping out and fires this wide to beat the bat, Samson completes a smart stumping. Third wicket for Tewatia. That's been called wide, but doesn't matter, the Royals have prised out a big scalp.
eased wide of point for a single
goes again and gets six more! This one's a lot straighter, smashes into the sightscreen. This is once again tossed up, Gaikwad made room and swung through cleanly
down the track and boom! Clears long-off quite comfortably. Nimble footwork again as he got to the pitch.
beaten as he has a swing at this one. Phillips fired this outside Moeen's hitting arc
struck on the pad as he looks to swing this length delivery into the leg side
eased to sweeper cover as Gaikwad raises his half-century, seventh in the IPL
driven but can't pierce the ring at cover
steps out and squeezes this down to long-off
drifts a full delivery across, steered wide of point
bhaaaam! This is poor bowling, too short and Moeen rocks back to wallop the pull that sails over deep midwicket
swept hard, but Dube with some terrific athleticism as he puts in a dive after a sprint to save two at deep midwicket
has a wild heave at this wrong'un, gets a thick inside edge onto the boot, gets back into the crease even as the ball nearly rolls back towards the keeper
rocks back and pulls this short ball on off to deep square leg
whips this uppishly to deep midwicket
excellent use of the feet as he swats this googly into the gap to find the long-on boundary
edged and this beats short third man, Lewis with the chase as he hurls the throw back, two more for Gaikwad as he inches towards yet another half-century
picks the length early as he rocks back and pulls to deep midwicket
driven with the spin to wide long-off, all along the ground
goes over cover again and he picks the gap as easily as you can find kanda poha in Pune! Wide long-off and deep cover had no chance.
tossed up but spins it away from the wide line, left alone and wide called.
swept fiercely into the gap at deep square, good work running around the ropes by Markande
flat-bats it down to long-off
worked with the spin into the leg side
drifts in a length delivery on middle, tucked into the gap at midwicket
shortish on middle and leg, whipped to deep midwicket
chips down the track and drives with the spin to long-off
typical Gaikwad stroke, a lovely inside-out shot over extra cover! Made room, got under the flight, opened the bat face slightly and picked the gap as he lofted it with the spin.
lands a flipper that fizzes through on middle, pushed to cover
bowls short again, and this time on middle and off. Pulled powerfully to deep square leg
punches this good length ball on off to deep point, with the ball angling in

bouncer to Moeen, and how often you expect that! Called first bouncer by the umpire. That is pretty short on middle and off, and too high for Moeen to pull. Akash has a little chirp with Moeen after that, as the umpire asks him to calm down - for the second time today
good length ball just outside off at 137kph. Looks to dab at that, but gets it off the bottom of the bat toward third man
pulls this short delivery on off, which is angling into him, to deep square leg
short of a length and just outside off. Punched to cover from deep in his crease
firmly drives this full ball on off to the man at cover with a slightly open face of the bat
punches this good length ball outside off to long-off with the full face of the bat
good length ball on middle, and flicked to deep midwicket. Gaikwad wanted two, but was sent back by Moeen

Raina holes out at deep midwicket! Goes down on his back knee to sweep this full ball on middle, with the ball also tossed up. But that was sent only high and without much power, with the ball landing exactly where the man was placed, as he didn't have to move an inch. Tewatia is pumped up, as it is another low score for Raina, as his poor season continues
fuller on middle, and turning away. Skips down to push that to long-on
short of a length on middle, and just bisects long-on and deep midwicket with his pull! Excellent placement there. Right in the gap there
another fine stop at point! The fielder dives to his left, as Gaikwad cuts this short of a length ball outside off, with the turn away from him
fuller in length on middle, and turning away. Pushed to cover away from his body
short of a length on leg, and pulled to short fine leg
good diving stop by point to his left! This was again short and wide of off, and cut away
slower, and fuller and wide of off. Cut away to fine the man at point
good length ball on middle, and turning into him. Clipped toward midwicket
good length ball and wide of off. Crunched down to long-off to get off the mark

stumped with ease! There was no turn there, and du Plessis is foxed by the ball coming on with the angle. He skips down early to try and loft at that good length ball on middle, but the ball sneaks in between his bat and pad to provide Samson with enough time to flick the bails
shorter in length on middle, and pulled to deep midwicket from deep in his crease
gets this push off the inside edge to long-on, as he looks to play at this full ball on middle and off
goes much fuller on middle and off, and drives that to long-off with the full face of the bat
comes down to this full ball on middle, and taps it back to the bowler
low full-toss on middle, and driven to mid-off with the open face of the bat. Gaikwad has to dive at the bowler's end as the throw arrives

collision between du Plessis and Mustafizur at the bowler's end! The bowler was busy looking at the ball, which was pushed to mid-off off a full length on off, whereas du Plessis rammed into him while running quickly and trying to complete that single. du Plessis was down for a moment - remember he has just recovered from a long lay-off with concussion - as Mustafizur looked to be concerned about his right leg
fired over long-on! The offcutter from Mustafizur on a full length on middle, but du Plessis reads him early and skips down after making room to hammer that with the free swing of the arms

creams this drive, and there is fumble at cover to allow a single. Full length ball just outside off, and in the driving length. He presents the full face of the bat to that, and gets it right off the middle
continues bowling with a change of pace. This is full on his pads, as Gaikwad jams that back to the bowler's right
another slower ball, and this is full on off. du Plessis is deep in his crease while driving that to deep point
beaten on his pull! The ball is on a good length just outside off and even keeps a little low, as Gaikwad goes deep in his crease and across off to pull, but can't get bat on ball
slower ball on middle, and clipped to square leg after playing late
good delivery! Sakariya sees him coming down the track early, and pitches it short on middle and leg. du Plessis ducks under it, as the ball gets good bounce and carry to the keeper
pushes at that short and wide delivery outside off to point while reaching out for it
flayed away over short third man! Again he backs away and comes down, as he slashes at that short and wide ball outside off, but this time the ball takes the outside edge
skips down a touch, makes room and drills that to the right of mid-off! Drives with a flat bat, as the man inside the circle dives to his right, but in vain
another ball with a change of pace. This is on a good length on middle, and is dabbed toward point
and change of pace now. Pretty full on middle at 112kph, and du Plessis nudges it toward cover with his front leg out of the way
good length on middle, and angling away after getting good bounce too. Flicked to deep square leg for another single
pushes this full ball just outside off all along the ground to the man at deep point
change of pace, and a slower ball on a full length on middle and off. Dabbed late toward point
very full on leg, and flicked toward midwicket. The fielder there dives to his left and gets a hand, but the ball trickles away to allow a single
good length ball just outside off, and clipped to mid-on from deep in his crease

outside edge, but that flies between keeper and short third man! Goes fishing at this full ball wide of off and plays away from his body with a horizontal bat. But there is a big gap there, and he is lucky to bag four
good length ball on leg, and clipped back to the bowler from deep in his crease
pushed toward cover, with the ball being short and slightly wide of off

the ball slips beneath the man at deep square leg, and it is a tough chance dropped by Phillips! Change of pace on a short of a length on leg, and pulled by du Plessis very forcefully. Goes right to the man there, who goes low to try and grab that, but the ball sneaks below him.
Really full on off, and he digs it out to the off side for a rapid run
this is bowled full on his pads, as he clips that to deep square leg. Good over by Sakariya to concede only two
slower delivery, and full and just outside off. Waits for it come, before dabbing that to point
full and straighter on off. He blocks toward cover with his head right down
goes even fuller and just outside off, and pushes at it toward cover to get off the mark
drives this full delivery just outside off to mid-off now
full delivery on off, and tapped to point after going low

cut away beyond the cover fielder! Again Akash goes short and wide of off, and Gaikwad plays that away from his body to slash that to the left of the fielder. Great start by Super Kings with ten off the first over
short of a length just outside off, and dabbed toward third man. Beats the man inside the circle to his right by playing that late, and pockets a quick two
and this time it is a fine save by point! Markande the fielder there, who dives to his right, as Gaikwad guides that fullish ball just outside off by opening the bat face
goes for the drive again to this full ball just outside off, and again finds cover
cover dives to his left to stop that. Short and wide of off, and goes for the cut, but doesn't find the gap
presents the full face of the bat, and sends the ball right back for four first ball! Places that full ball on middle and off between the non-striker and the stumps at the other end. Excellent start
punched to sweeper cover. That is that. The Royals win and this has been some run chase!
eased down to long-off
up and over, but down towards long-on and long-off
deposited over deep square leg! Walked across, swivelled back and absolutely belted that with the kind of swagger the Universe Boss would approve of.
chipped over the infield to deep midwicket
back of length and angling away, punched to deep cover
crisply driven into the gap at deep extra cover for two more
clears his front leg and scythes this into the gap at deep extra cover! Curran went length, Phillips had enough time to make room and give that a smack

what happened there? Curran slips one out of his hand as Phillips goes chasing after this high ball, well behind the stumps, towards Dhoni. Eventually bails out. Everyone has a laugh.  Free hit coming up
works this to deep square
rises with the bounce and cuts, but this is an excellent stop by Rayudu at point
full outside off, pushed to cover
he's picked out Gaikwad at deep square! This was a superbly timed pull, but it was almost as if Samson forgot there was a man there.
looks to swing this high full toss across the line, lands in no man's land, between the bowler and the long-on fielder running in. Dube thought this was a no-ball, tight call.
slower yorker angled across, beaten as he looks to squeeze it down to third man
absolutely belted over extra cover. Uthappa, substituting for Faf, had a lot of work running around from wide long-off, but stood no chance.
cramped for room as he tucks this length ball to the leg side
firm push to Raina at extra cover
swings and misses, deflects towards fine leg off the thigh pad
slower and fuller, dug out to mid-off
helped along one bounce to the fine leg boundary! Dug in short and down leg, easy pickings.
slower length ball, forceful hit to mid-off, not timed well
pushes this down to long-on to raise a maiden IPL fifty
beaten as he chases a length ball slanting away. Wide called and rightly so
nearly onto the stumps! Goes full outside off, Dube pushes at that with minimal feet movement, rolled off a thick insid eedge.
right on top of the bounce as he runs it down to third man
bunts this high full toss down to long-off, opportunity missed. Was a gift of a delivery
sprays it into the pads, Samson clips it nicely off his pads to deep square leg
reaches out to squirt this wide of cover point
slips this slower delivery too far wide outside off, wide called as Dube leaves
worked off his hip to deep square
uses the pace to steer this towards backward point, a half-stop that is parried towards third man gives them a single
slips this friendly length ball on middle and leg, Samson cajoles this off his hip to the fine leg boundary. Did that with oodles of love. No brute force that time.
whips this into the gap at deep backward square leg. This is Dube's IPL highest
slapped over point. Too much width from Hazlewood. The difference a couple of days can make. Player of the Match in the previous game, inching towards a half-century here.
off the thigh pad and into the leg side
looks to heave this across the line, but Curran is beaten

oh dear, Curran has copped a sickening blow on his left thigh! He's in pain. Dube absolutely drilled this down the ground. Curran had absolutely less than a split-second to react. Saved a certain boundary. He's up on his feet and walking away towards his mark.
he's absolutely bludgeoned that over deep midwicket! Sam Curran goes full, bowls another juicy full toss and Dube muscles this over the ropes. Clean swing, super stuff.
slower ball but drags this down leg, Dube swings and misses. Another wide
gets the boundary but it wasn't far from a diving Jadeja at wide long-on! This was a slower ball, may have slipped out of his hand, turned out to be a full toss that Dube swung across the line
beaten as he has a go at that one, umpire thinks it was way outside the wide line. Tight call, me thinks
toe-ends a massive swing downtown, Uthappa comes in from long-off to stop that
in the slot, Dube hammers this but can't beat a diving Moeen at extra cover
excellent slower yorker on off, squeezed to deep cover
dug in short and into the body at 141.1kph, Samson plays the short-arm jab to deep square.  Oh, dear. It's a no-ball as Asif oversteps.  It was a fantastic over up until now.
nearly chopped on! Instead, this one rolls wide of leg stump as Dhoni runs across to stop that
slower and fuller outside off, Samson plays a crisp drive to deep cover
hamnmered back as Asif is hit on the boot on his followthrough, he deflected it down to long-on
nicely-disguised slower delivery outside off, Samson steers this down to square third man
slapped away, went in a jiffy to Rayudu at deep cover
really full on off, and drilled to long-on
good length ball on off, and clipped to long-on from deep in his crease
short again, and outside off. Turning away, and pushed to long-off with the horizontal bat
right back over the bowler's head! Attacks this full ball outside off, as he opens the bat face to lift that wayyyy up and over for the maximum
swiveled over deep midwicket! Hangs back deep in his crease to this short ball on middle and off, and pulls with disdain. Another six!
short and outside off. Turns away, as Dube cuts that back to the bowler
tosses it up and bowls very full on middle. Pushed back to the bowler with the closed face of the bat
fullish on off, and jammed back to the man at cover
back of a length outside off, and pushed to point, where the fielder dives to his right to stop that. Appreciation from Jadeja too
really full outside off, and drug out to deep point, where Curran runs to his left to cut that off
slices that high to deep point, and on the bounce. This time Jadeja goes full and outside off, as Dube opens the bat face
hammered a hundred miles beyond long-on! Stays deep in his crease, and rams that full ball in the slot on middle to welcome Jadeja with a six
short and outside off, cut away to deep point
Dube dances down, but gets the toe end of the bat as he tries to heave that full ball on off away from his body. The ball rolls over toward slip
good length ball on middle, and pushed back to the bowler
bowls slower, and on a full length on off. Tapped to point
fuller outside off, and a hint of turn into him. Clipped toward deep midwicket, as Samson is sent back after wanting a second
reverse-sweeps it deep point! Good length ball outside off, and he rolls his wrists after getting into his position early
dabs this good length ball on off from close to his body, as Dhoni scampers across to his right to stop that
full delivery on his pads, and clips that between fine leg and deep square leg! That was pitched on leg, and angling into him too, as Samson just uses the pace of the ball to loft that for four
cover slides to his left, but can't get a hand, as Dube drives at this full ball outside off to mid-off
bowls short again, and on middle and off. Good pace and bounce, and Dube is beaten on his cut
leans into it away from his body, as Asif bowls full and wide of off. That is played aerially, and deep point runs to his left to stop that

and Asif strikes first ball! Bowls short on leg, as Jaiswal goes low and down on his knee only to have a late clip at that. The ball takes his glove on the way, and lands right in the gloves of Dhoni. That could well be a match-changing innings here

short and wide of off, and cut away to deep point! Plays away from his body, with the ball angling away, and beats both cover and cover-point to end the powerplay with a four. Royals rake up 81 in six overs with that, phew!
fuller ball on off, and clipped to midwicket with the closed face of the bat
dabs that short and wide ball outside off to the mat at cover-point
in the driving length just outside off, and nudged to mid-off with the full face of the bat

nabbed at fine leg! Super Kings can breathe now. Thakur is pumped up. It was a short delivery on middle and leg, and Lewis looked to repeat that pull with a swivel, but Hazlewood was right back on the edge of the fine leg fence, and doesn't have to move anywhere. An aggressive partnership is broken, after Royals give Super Kings some early shock

Substitute fielder Uthappa runs back from cover, but the ball doesn't quite get into his outstretched hand. Lewis lofts that full ball outside off with the open face of the bat, and sends that up in the air, but safely in the end
goes for the slash to this back of a length ball outside off, but is beaten
six over mid-off! Fifty off just 19 balls. That was right in the slot on off, and he got his front leg out of the way and remained deep in his crease to loft that back over the bowler's head

rammed over covers! That is pretty full and just outside off, and Jaiswal is waiting for it deep in his crease. He lofts that with the open face of the bat, and bang for four. Hazlewood being given the treatment here
two in a row! Again he rocks back in the crease to this good length ball outside off - a touch short of a length too - as this time Jaiswal pulls over mid-on to leave the bowler frustrated
and now Jaiswal goes for the pull! Hazlewood bowls with a change of pace on a short of a length on off, and Jaiswal stays deep in his crease to slam that away with disdain
goes driving at this full ball on off, but finds Moeen at cover, who is right on the edge of the circle

crashed into the deep midwicket stands! That also brings up the fifty in only four overs. Thakur goes short again on middle and leg, as Lewis pulls that forcefully to send that flat and furious for six
another short delivery, but this is without pace and on leg stump. He lets that go after swaying away his head last moment
pulls behind the wicket to fine leg! A fielder is there on the fence, but is pretty wide. Short of a length ball on middle, and he swivels to pull that for another four
slices this full delivery outside off to third man with the open face of the bat
fuller on off, and clipped back to the left of the bowler, who got the ball angling into the batter
good length delivery on off, and pushed to mid-off. Lewis runs late for that single, as Curran's throw at the bowler's end doesn't find the stumps
waits for the slower ball to come to him, and pulls that short delivery on off to deep midwicket off the higher side of the bat
change of pace, and a really full length ball outside off. Digs that out to the left of short third man
another outside edge, and in between slip and short third man! Looks to punch this good length ball outside off with the open face of the bat, but gets that off the outside half of the bat
another short of a length ball outside off, and pulled to deep midwicket again. But this time there is a man back on the boundary
pulled to deep midwicket! Short of a length on middle by Curran, and Lewis is deep in his crease to swivel while playing that pull. This is some start by Royals here
scythed over long-on! Opens the bat face to this good length ball on middle, and sends that sailing over the fence for six!

crunched between cover and cover-point! Back of a length ball just outside off, and he hops in his crease to punch that ball just outside off. Two fours in a row, and Hazlewood doesn't have a good start
flicked to deep midwicket! Full delivery in the slot on middle, and uses his wrists to whack that away

dropped by Rayudu! Jaiswal pulls a good length ball on middle, and sends that milesss into the sky. Rayudu runs back and claims the catch, but the ball pops out of his hand. It was a tough catch though
this is much fuller and just outside off. Closes the bat face to push that back, as Hazlewood stretches out his right hand atop, and the ball rolls over to the stumps at his end
outside edge, and enough to beat the man at slip! Good length ball on off, and angling across. He opens the bat face late, but gets it off the edge for four
cuts that late after swaying away a touch to this good length ball just outside off. Third man runs to his left, and goes low to stop that
fuller ball and just outside off. He opens the bat face to dab that to the left of short third man for a single, with a man back on the boundary too
full and a touch wide of off. Tapped toward point away from his body, with the ball keeping a touch low
chipped over the bowler's head! Another full delivery on middle and off which is swinging away, as he lobs that with the full face of the bat
goes fuller and just outside off, with the ball angling away. Jaiswal times his drive well - although that is aerial for a second - and beats mid-off to his right
dabs this good length ball just outside off, but finds short third man
pulls this good length ball just outside off to deep square leg while playing with a swivel
